tickets.what: Repair of milestone review j3173891f358ab140 findings 1, 2, 3, 5 (nav-redesign/07). (1) src/collectors/execution.ts ~207–228 stamps every queue-run ticket's `ended` activity with `run.endedAt`, so a ticket landed yesterday reads 'landed 5m' when the queue finished 5 minutes ago, and old landings re-enter the ≤ 24 h window; this also feeds the Objective page activity note. Use the individual landing/settlement time (item.changedAt or the job/land receipt time) for both age and the 24 h eligibility. (2) Project resolves a ticket's job ID from target_hint/ticket filename/task text (src/collectors/ticket-rollup.ts:37–51) but execution.ts only keys ticket activity from `ticket`/`slice` receipt fields, so src/render/feature-detail.ts:149–154 shows 'working' from ticket.job with no execJob: Enter expands the checklist and g/P/H cannot reach the worker. Join the already-resolved ticket.job.id to the execution worker/target (jobTargetFor); do not infer a second identity in the renderer. (3) feature-detail.ts ~268–282: when a job observation exists the state word is dropped except for `try`. The ticket says each row carries state mark, word, blockers (← NN) and the job status; make the full-width candidate state word + blockers + status, and shorten (blockers, then word) only when the row runs out of cells. (4) feature-detail.ts:236 orders done tickets by max(file mtime, ledger time, job time), so editing an old ticket or a checkout reorders done. Prefer a dated landing/completion observation (ledger/land receipt/Landed comment); use file mtime only when none exists.
